Full-body character design for a stylised 3D video game, an original character: a living sack of potatoes from a forge town. A squat, lumpy sack of coarse brown jute burlap, wider at the bottom than the top, tied shut at the top with a frayed rope so the gathered cloth makes a floppy tuft. The two bottom corners are knotted into stubby feet and the two upper corners are knotted into small round fists that stick out at the sides. A large square leather patch is stitched onto its belly with thick uneven thread, and a faded stencilled potato emblem sits beside it. Its face is sewn on: two mismatched buttons for eyes, one large brass button and one smaller wooden button, and a short zigzag stitched mouth with a confident grin. Two real potatoes with small green sprouts peek out of a tear near its shoulder. Soot smudges and a few scorched threads. Chunky stylised proportions, clean readable shapes, hand-painted look. Front view, standing upright, fists held away from the body, feet slightly apart. Soft even studio lighting, plain light grey background, no text, no cast shadows.
